title: Eric Henry Wang's name on DTIC engineering documents

tellings.quote: yes he no he he existed he existed if you look through the DTick the defense technical information center you can find actual um you can find uh old engineering documents with air Henry weighing on it

plain: An engineer named Eric Henry Wang, who appears in UFO stories about Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio in the 1950s, was a real person, according to a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb. UAPGerb says you can find old engineering documents with Wang's name on them in the Defense Technical Information Center, the Pentagon's archive of technical reports. That would show at least that a figure from the stories really existed and did engineering work for the military.
